title: Drop QueryObject impls and CalendarFilterCondition for query-less types
description:
Freeze audit 2 survivor, vote 2/3.

## [JMAP-wf92.25] QueryObject impls (and a public CalendarFilterCondition) exist for three types the drafts give no /query method
Crates: jmap-calendars-types, jmap-tasks-types
Evidence: crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/backend.rs:226-231 has `impl QueryObject for Calendar { type Filter = CalendarFilter; type Comparator = serde_json::Value; }`. The comment there says -33 'defines no Calendar/query'. backend.rs:280-288 has `impl QueryObject for ParticipantIdentity { Filter = Value; Comparator = Value }`. crate-jmap-tasks-types/src/backend.rs:236-244 has `impl QueryObject for TaskList { Filter = Value; Comparator = Value }`. crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/calendar.rs:212-233 exports `CalendarFilterCondition { name, is_subscribed }` with deny_unknown_fields, plus `CalendarFilter` (re-exported at lib.rs:47). Its doc cites 'Calendar/query (draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-33 §4.5)', but that section does not exist. The -33 TOC (draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-33.txt:78-80, 82-84) lists only ParticipantIdentity/get,changes,set and Calendar/get,changes,set. The tasks-06 TOC (draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06.txt:77-79) lists only TaskList/get,changes,set. No server registers these methods (calendars-server lib.rs:95-97 omits Calendar/query on purpose, per bd:JMAP-ic0j.7). A workspace grep finds no query_objects/QueryParams/QueryChangesParams use for any of the three types. Canonical mail implements QueryObject only for its /query types (mail-types backend.rs:219,242,269; none for Thread, Identity or VacationResponse), and contacts gives AddressBook none. In the probe, a single generic `query_objects<O>` over every extension compiled fine. These impls are reachable only through public generics and are dead surface.
Why breaking later: Removing a public trait impl, or the exported CalendarFilterCondition/CalendarFilter types, breaks any downstream code that names them, for example `QueryParams<'_, Calendar>` or a client building a CalendarFilterCondition. After 0.4 they cannot be dropped without a major bump. Until then the crate publishes a filter wire shape (`name`, `isSubscribed`) that no spec defines, and three `Value` placeholders that JMAP-wf92.25 could only leave untyped. A future draft could add Calendar/query with different filter properties, and the invented type would then conflict with it.
Fix: Delete `impl QueryObject` for Calendar, ParticipantIdentity and TaskList, and delete CalendarFilterCondition, the CalendarFilter alias and their re-exports. This matches canonical mail, where query-less types are only JmapObject/GetObject/SetObject. Update the CHANGELOG/AGENTS.md list that wf92.25 says names these types as exceptions to the typed-comparator rule.
Size: S

Its doc cites "Calendar/query (§4.5)". Grepping the specs: draft-ietf-jmap-ca; REFUTE: Refuted on criteria (b) and (c). DECISION Mark 2026-10-22: fix it (recommended option). Implement now; do not ask again.
History: all three impls came from scaffolding commit 537fac26 (2026-05-04), which gave every type a QueryObject impl. calendars-26 mentions 'Calendar/query' once in passing (Calendar/get text, line 977) but defines no such method (TOC 4.1-4.3 get/changes/set); -33 removed the mention; tasks-06 never had TaskList/query. A proposed /query extension is tracked separately (see the query-interface bead).
